concerns.text: The plan states that the two illusion‑behavioral datasets will be fetched from the same OpenNeuro parquet URLs (see the “Verified datasets” block). However, the Müller‑Lyer training set and the Ponzo test set are distinct visual tasks and require separate data files. Using the identical URL for both datasets (as also listed in research.md) would provide the wrong modality for the Ponzo analysis, making the dataset inappropriate for the research question.
